name: User - Edit Field Before Submission
goal: Test that a user can preview the application, choose to edit a specific field, and then successfully submit.
constraints: User edits 'Car Model' after preview, then submits.

phases.description: User fills all details and previews application.
User selects 'Edit', chooses 'Car Model', and provides new value.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot re-collects car model and returns to preview/submit.
Bot confirms submission with final message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
